title: Szeretne: Asking What Someone Else Would Like

sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Szeretne (third person, no -k) is how you ask someone else what they would like — a waiter uses it with a guest, or you can use it to ask a friend.

items.english: Would you like chicken or beef?
I would like the set meal because I'm hungry.

sections.content: Szeretne csirkét vagy marhát? offers a choice with vagy, just like Unit 23's Szeretne limonádét vagy üdítőt?
